"""Main: commit closed official full32K and new integration admission evidence."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
D = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009')
W = D.parent / 'sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
F = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('official_long_boundary_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def identity(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)

def compact(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            if any(word in key.lower() for word in ('token', 'api')) and isinstance(item,str) and len(item)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in item):
                result[key] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key == 'token_logprob_sha256':
                result['token_logprob_identity'] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key in ('evidence','command_evidence') and isinstance(item,dict) and all(isinstance(fields,dict) and all(isinstance(text,str) for text in fields.values()) for fields in item.values()):
                result[key] = {label:{channel:dict(bytes=len(text.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    content=text if len(text.encode()) <= 16384 else text[:8192]+'\n[compact middle omitted]\n'+text[-4096:])
                    for channel,text in fields.items()} for label,fields in item.items()}
            else:
                result[key] = compact(item)
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [compact(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and len(value.encode()) > 32768:
        return dict(bytes=len(value.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    head=value[:8192], tail=value[-4096:], scope='Compact derivative; exact original remains pinned for current admission consumer')
    return value


import statistics

ROOT = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v6'
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-results-boundary-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[],
             controller=identity(Path(__file__)), gpu_executed=False, artifacts=[])
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    start = time.monotonic()
    staged = out / 'staged'
    staged.mkdir()
    prepared = []
    def write(relative, value):
        p = staged / relative
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
        assert len(raw.encode()) < 1 << 20, (relative, len(raw.encode()))
        p.write_text(raw)
        prepared.append((p, F / relative))
    def run(label, argv, cwd=D):
        left = 600 - (time.monotonic() - start)
        assert left > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=min(120, left), cpu=480,
            rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    def archive_receipt(p):
        value = json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert not value.get('active', False)
        for c in value.get('commands', []) + value.get('guard_commands', []):
            assert c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored']
            assert c['ownership_status'] == 'observed' and not c['cleanup'] and not c['survivors']
        name = str(p.relative_to(B)).replace('/', '--')
        write('receipts-v158/' + name, dict(original=identity(p), derivative=True,
            original_status_preserved=True, original_passed=value.get('passed'), receipt=compact(value)))
        return value
    try:
        assert not run('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert run('branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
        assert run('origin', ['/usr/bin/git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) == 'git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in
            run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        summary = json.loads((ROOT / 'campaign-summary.json').read_text())
        assert summary['passed'] and summary['complete'] and not summary['active']
        assert len(summary['individual_receipts']) == 11
        samples = []
        for path, digest in summary['individual_receipts'].items():
            p = Path(path)
            assert m.sha(p) == digest
            v = archive_receipt(p)
            assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and v['model_normal_close'] and v['kernel_gate_passed'] and v['boot_unchanged']
            assert all(c['exit_code'] == 0 and c['observation_complete'] and not c.get('errors')
                       for c in v['commands'] + v['guard_commands'])
            assert not v.get('error') and not v.get('primary_model_failure')
            for key, item in v.items():
                if key.startswith('kernel-') and isinstance(item, dict):
                    assert not item.get('fault_entries') and not item.get('dump_present')
            for key in ('startup_diagnostics', 'startup_protocol_diagnostics', 'post_ready_diagnostics',
                        'final_diagnostics', 'protocol_diagnostics'):
                if key in v:
                    assert not v[key]['severe_messages']
            if v.get('pair_comparison'):
                assert v['pair_comparison']['token_logprob_equal']
            if v.get('validation'):
                assert v['validation']['generated_tokens'] == 16
                assert len(v['validation']['output_ids']) == 16 and len(v['validation']['token_logprob_lines']) == 32
            samples.append(v)
        assert sum(bool(v.get('pair_comparison')) for v in samples) == 5
        archive_receipt(ROOT / 'campaign-summary.json')
        for p in sorted(B.glob('latest-update-main-integrated-v6-provider-health-xe-*-root-v1/record.json')):
            v = archive_receipt(p)
            assert v['passed'] and v['kernel_gate_passed'] and v['boot_unchanged']
            text = v['evidence']['integer-health']['stdout']
            lines = text.splitlines()
            assert lines[:6] == v['health_protocol']
            assert {line.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for line in lines[6:]} == set(v['mapped_libraries'])
            assert all(line.startswith('LIBRARY ') for line in lines[6:])
            assert all(m.sha(p) == item['sha256'] for p, item in v['mapped_libraries'].items())
        for name in ('latest-update-main-integrated-results-boundary-root-v1', 'latest-update-main-integrated-control-boundary-root-v1',
                     'latest-update-main-cache512-qualification-root-v2', 'latest-update-main-cache512-cpu-root-v2',
                     'latest-update-main-cache512-compile-root-v2', 'latest-update-main-cache512-property-root-v2',
                     'latest-update-main-cache512-admission-root-v2'):
            p = B / name / 'record.json'
            if p.exists():
                archive_receipt(p)
        stats = {}
        for arm in ('off', 'on'):
            group = [next(v for v in samples if v['phase'] == 'timed' + str(i) + '-' + arm) for i in (1, 2, 3)]
            values = [dict(phase=v['phase'], receipt_sha256=m.sha(ROOT / ('xe-' + v['phase']) / 'record.json'),
                prefill_ms=v['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'], decode_ms=v['validation']['engine_decode_ms'],
                prefill_tokens_per_second=32768000 / v['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'],
                decode_tokens_per_second=16000 / v['validation']['engine_decode_ms']) for v in group]
            stats[arm] = dict(individual_samples=values, count=3)
            for field in ('prefill_tokens_per_second', 'decode_tokens_per_second'):
                seq = [v[field] for v in values]
                stats[arm][field] = dict(mean=statistics.mean(seq), sample_stddev=statistics.stdev(seq),
                    minimum=min(seq), maximum=max(seq), sample_cv=statistics.stdev(seq) / statistics.mean(seq))
        delta = [100 * (stats['on']['individual_samples'][i]['decode_tokens_per_second'] /
                        stats['off']['individual_samples'][i]['decode_tokens_per_second'] - 1) for i in range(3)]
        write('integrated-full32k-clean-results-v158.json', dict(main_reviewed=True,
            source_revision='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035', campaign=identity(ROOT / 'campaign-summary.json'),
            statistics=stats, paired_decode_percent_change_on_vs_off=delta,
            measurement_order=[v['phase'] for v in samples],
            individual_correctness_samples=compact(summary['individual_samples']),
            normal_close_and_fault_checks_passed_for_all_11_roots=True,
            comparisons='All five arm pairs have equal 16 generated IDs and reported LP5. Full vocabulary/quality not compared.',
            heldout_whole_input_tokens=37462, production_guard_default_removed=False,
            decision='Keep existing production nonfinite detection. Three decode pairs have mixed directions; no reproducible removal benefit established. Batched prefill does not invoke this guard, so its timing delta is not attributed to guard cost.',
            provider_review='Main independently parsed completed native six-record integer protocol, deduplicated LIBRARY mapped segments into exact diagnostic8/clean7 paths, and rehashed libraries; unique map counts are not raw mapping-segment counts.',
            full262144_runtime_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False, optimal_upstream_settings_qualified=False,
            next='Pristine official cache512 capability/admission and actual32K; source-eligible cache auto or worker3 remain separate candidates. Full physical262144 runtime and correctness remain open.'))
        entries = []
        reports = []
        for number in range(241, 247):
            found = list((B / 'research-20261009').glob('*round' + str(number) + '-v1.txt'))
            assert len(found) == 1
            reports += found
        reports.append(B / 'research-20261009/implementation-main-cache512-helpers-source-v1.txt')
        for p in reports:
            relative = 'research/' + p.name
            target = staged / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(p.read_text().rstrip('\n') + '\n')
            prepared.append((target, F / relative))
            entries.append(dict(original=identity(p), archive=relative, archive_identity=identity(target),
                normalization='Only repeated EOF newlines normalized; original unchanged',
                model='gpt-6.1-sol' if p.name.startswith('implementation-') else 'gpt-6-luna',
                main_full_report_review=True, status='completed', measured=False))
        previous = F / 'report-registry-v157.json'
        assert json.loads(previous.read_text())['research_completed'] == 741
        write('report-registry-v158.json', dict(research_completed=741 + len(entries),
            prior_registry_path=str(previous.relative_to(D)), prior_registry_sha256=m.sha(previous),
            new_reports=entries, main_sole_execution_owner=True,
            corrections=['Publisher1 secret scan rejected two source-hash map entries named include/strata/hip_compat/cuda_runtime_api.h; verified both are64hex source SHA values. New derivative nests API-named source hashes under sha256 without changing originals; original publisher1 FAILED preserved.', 'R244 cache/profile data independently inspected but quoted generic src locations; actual compiled official sizing/fill is sycl/src/program/generate.cpp. Geometry/profile are identical; generic locations are not compiled-path proof.',
                         'R246 describes R238 as a census contract; actual R238 is the large-batch USM marker safety audit.',
                         'R243 source drift is conditional, not observed. Main wrapper2 rechecks exact helper manifest and file pins before/after each stage and compares each actual stage helper pins. Parent controller work remains outside child resource limits.']))
        sources = [B / name for name in ('latest-update-main-canonicalize-r242-v1.py',
            'latest-update-main-r242-canonicalization-v1.json', 'latest-update-main-cache512-qualification-v1.py',
            'latest-update-main-cache512-qualification-v2.py', 'latest-update-main-cache512-phase-v1.py', 'latest-update-main-integrated-results-boundary-v1.py', Path(__file__).name)]
        for folder in ('latest-update-main-cache512-helpers-source-v1', 'latest-update-main-cache512-helpers-source-v2'):
            sources += [p for p in sorted((B / folder).iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py', '.json', '.txt', '.patch')]
        index = []
        for i, p in enumerate(sources):
            relative = 'controller-sources-v158/' + str(i).zfill(3) + '-' + p.parent.name + '-' + p.name + '.json'
            write(relative, dict(identity=identity(p), content=p.read_text()))
            index.append(dict(original=identity(p), archive=relative))
        write('controller-source-v158.json', dict(files=index, scope='Source archive is not execution proof; actual stage receipts separate'))
        leak = out / 'secret-scan.json'
        run('private-secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(staged), '--no-banner', '--redact',
                                  '--report-format', 'json', '--report-path', str(leak)])
        assert json.loads(leak.read_text()) == []
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', str(W / 'tools/lint/run.sh'), *[str(p) for p, _ in prepared if p.suffix == '.json']], cwd=W)
        for p, target in prepared:
            assert not target.exists()
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
            r['artifacts'].append(identity(target))
        run('whole-secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(F), '--no-banner', '--redact'])
        run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', *[str(p.relative_to(D)) for _, p in prepared]])
        run('check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
        run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'docs(sycl): record repeated32K and held-out update qualification'])
        r['revision'] = run('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
